_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. body.en: It sounds like time. It is not. Whatever you are telling yourself you will sort out later, the room, the paperwork, the conversation, later has almost arrived.
body.hi: Sunne mein samay lagta hai. Hai nahi. Jo bhi aap khud se keh rahe hain ki baad mein kar lenge, kamra, kaagaz, woh baatcheet, woh baad ab lagbhag aa chuka hai.
